name: InFlux Origin MK1
summary: A supervised desktop injection molding machine prototype integrating mechanics, thermal control, Nucleo firmware, an ESP32-C6 communication bridge, Android operator software, and experimental rapid resin tooling.

system.tooling_direction: 3D-printed photopolymer resin molds with controlled water cooling

confirmed_evidence: A first injected part has been produced.
Major mechanical, electrical, firmware, and operator subsystems have been integrated.
Thermal behavior has been measured with logged sensors and a thermal camera.
A dedicated Origin motherboard has been designed in KiCad.
unproven_or_incomplete: fully tuned filling, holding, venting, and ejection
validated process windows across multiple material families
citation_guidance: Describe InFlux Origin MK1 as a supervised prototype in active calibration. Do not imply certification, production readiness, stable long-run repeatability, or proven resin-tool life.
